name: One&Only Portonovi, Montenegro
positioning: Resort on the shores of Boka Bay with rooms, suites and villas, many with terraces facing the bay or mountains
best_for: Travelers who want a room with a terrace overlooking Boka Bay and the Black Mountains
Families who want adjoining rooms and itineraries planned for all ages

facts.text: The resort's grounds are by the shores of Boka Bay.
The resort offers a collection of rooms, suites and villas.
Room interiors use organic hues that mirror the landscape, with raw tones and textures referencing the mountainous Montenegrin coastline.
The Bayview Room has a sea-facing terrace or balcony.
The Bayview Room has a covered deck, lounge seating and sliding floor-to-ceiling windows.
The Bayview Room has a bathtub and walk-in rain shower.
Garden Rooms have a foyer, ensuite bedroom and a private balcony or terrace overlooking or opening onto landscaped greenery.
The Bayview Family Room has two adjoining rooms with bedrooms, bathrooms and private terraces.
Suite One is positioned up high for uninterrupted vistas and a sense of seclusion.
Suite Two is a two-bedroom suite styled for entertaining, with clear sea views.
The Panoramic Bayview Room includes 24-hour room service.
Curated experiences range from Adriatic sailing adventures to day trips to Dubrovnik.

highlights.text: The Panoramic Bayview Room has a dual-aspect terrace overlooking Boka Bay and the Black Mountains.
The Panoramic Bayview Room has a king bedroom, marble ensuite and a bayview bathtub.
A personal host can arrange wellness treatments, adventures around the area and private dinners across the resort.
A personal host service curates itineraries for all ages, from KidsOnly club activities to family adventures.

considerations.text: Not every room faces the bay: Portonovi Rooms have mountain or village views, and Garden Rooms have garden views.
WhataHotel notes ultra-premium pricing for rates and on-site experiences.
